The structure of La2Mg14Fe2 (reduced formula LaMg7Fe) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 18 atoms per unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements for all three elements: La and Fe centers have 12 geometric neighbors, while Mg centers show 12 neighbors with varying La, Fe, and Mg compositions. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3D-connected component spanning all 18 sites, and validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among Mg-centered 12-vertex coordination polyhedra.
